descriere: Sets the hysteresis for the changeover speed/velocity of the motor model.
Sets the configuration for the modulator.
Sets the amplitude of the statistical wobbulation signal. This signal is used to vary the pulse frequency to create a more pleasant sound.
Sets the signal source to activate/de-activate offset calibration for output current measurement.
Sets bit 0 for recording the power unit in the subgroup for the "offset clocking".

descriere_scurta: Set phase for PWM generation manually
descriere: Sets manual setting and overwriting of automatically determined phase shift for "offset clocking". For p1816 = -1, the following applies: Automatic mode. The phase shift value is automatically determined. For p1816 = 0 ... 16, the following applies: Manual mode. The user should define the phase shift value as follows: 1. PWM cycle (1/p1800) > current controller clock cycle (p0115[0]) The power unit executes a phase shift from Tshift = current controller cycle (p0115[0]) * p1816. 2. PWM cycle (1/p1800) <= current controller clock cycle (p0115[0]) For p1816 >= 1, the power unit executes a phase shift from Tshift = PWM cycle/2.

descriere_scurta: Minimum ratio, pulse frequency to the output frequency
descriere: Sets the minimum ratio between the pulse frequency and the output frequency.

Sets the phase shift for offset clocking. For the first active power unit, it is specified whether clocking is to start at 0° (value = 0) or 180° (value = 1). All other active power units are clocked alternately according to the setting made here.

Display for "offset clocking". Depending on the particular case, the value is interpreted differently: Case 1: The PWM clock cycle is greater than the current controller clock cycle (p0115[0]) and the ratio between the PWM clock cycle and the current controller clock cycle and is an integer and even multiple of it (e.g. p0115[0] = 125 µs, pulse frequency = 4 kHz, 2 kHz). The value displayed refers to: - the phase shift in the current-controller cycles to be applied by the power unit. Case 2: The PWM clock cycle is less than or equal to the current controller clock cycle (p0115[0]) and the ratio between the current controller clock cycle and the PWM clock cycle is an integer and even multiple of it (e.g. p0115[0] = 125 µs, pulse frequency = 8 kHz, 16 kHz). The value 1 displayed means that: - the power unit is to apply a phase shift of 180 ° (from the PWM cycle). A value of 0 displayed on all power units of the drive line-up means the following: - the general conditions of the "offset clocking" (see p1815) are not fulfilled, i.e. no power unit is clocked with an offset.
Sets the threshold voltage drop of the valves (power semiconductor devices) to be compensated.

descriere_scurta: Infeed compensation valve lockout time operating mode
descriere: Sets the operating mode for the compensation of the valve lockout time.

descriere_scurta: Compensation valve lockout time phase U
descriere: Sets the valve lockout time to compensate for phase U.

descriere_scurta: Compensation valve lockout time phase V
descriere: Sets the valve lockout time to compensate for phase V.
Sets the factor for the plane compensation in the positive direction.
Sets the offset for the analog valve setpoint.

descriere_scurta: Motor data identification and rotating measurement
descriere: Sets the motor data identification and speed controller optimization.

Sets the signal source to start data identification. Data identification is started using binector input p1903 = 1 signal. When data identification is running, the function is canceled with binector input p1903 = 0 signal.

The fine encoder calibration should be started during the first commissioning or after the encoder is replaced. The fine calibration starts when the pulses are enabled and performs a rotating measurement (approximately 1 minute). In this case, a setpoint speed of at least 40 % of the motor rated speed must be entered, and the torque must be less than half of the motor rated torque. The phases of the fine calibration of displayed using alarm A07976. The fine calibration ends with the calculation of p0431 for the following pulse inhibit.
Activates the stationary data identification without enable.
Setting to activate the standstill data valve offset calibration when enabled.
Sets the number of phases to be identified.
Activates the moving measurement.
Sets the speed to determine the saturation characteristic and the encoder test. The percentage value is referred to p0310 (rated motor frequency).

Sets the speed for the identification of the moment of inertia and the vibration test. Induction motor: The percentage value is referred to p0310 (rated motor frequency). Synchronous motor: The percentage value is referred to the minimum from p0310 (rated motor frequency) and p1082 (maximum speed).
Sets the dynamic response factor for speed controller optimization. After optimization, the dynamic response achieved is displayed in r1968.

descriere_scurta: Speed_ctrl_opt saturation characteristic rotor flux maximum
descriere: Sets the maximum flux setpoint to measure the saturation characteristic.
Starts the pole position identification routine for test purposes.

descriere_scurta: Encoder adjustment determine angular commutation offset
descriere: This function is only required for synchronous motors and can be started when commissioning for the first time or after replacing an encoder. The function acts on the active motor data set. When adjusting the encoder, the angular commutation offset is determined and transferred into p0431. Alarm A07971 is output while the angular commutation offset is being determined. p1990 is automatically set to 0 after the angular commutation offset has been determined.

Sets the reference quantity for the frequency. All frequencies specified as relative value are referred to this reference quantity. The reference quantity corresponds to 100% or 4000 hex (word) or 4000 0000 hex (double word). The following applies: Reference frequency (in Hz)

Sets the reference quantity for voltages. All voltages specified as relative value are referred to this reference quantity. This also applies for direct voltage values (= rms value) like the DC-link voltage. The reference quantity corresponds to 100% or 4000 hex (word) or 4000 0000 hex (double word).

Sets the reference quantity for currents. All currents specified as relative value are referred to this reference quantity. The reference quantity corresponds to 100% or 4000 hex (word) or 4000 0000 hex (double word).

Sets the reference quantity for forces. All forces specified as relative value are referred to this reference quantity. The reference quantity corresponds to 100% or 4000 hex (word) or 4000 0000 hex (double word).

Sets the reference quantity for angle. All angles specified as relative value are referred to this reference quantity. The reference quantity corresponds to 100% or 4000 hex (word) or 4000 0000 hex (double word).

Sets the reference quantity for temperature. All temperatures specified as relative value are referred to this reference quantity. The reference quantity corresponds to 100% or 4000 hex (word) or 4000 0000 hex (double word).

Sets the reference quantity for acceleration rates. All acceleration rates specified as relative value are referred to this reference quantity. The reference quantity corresponds to 100% or 4000 hex (word) or 4000 0000 hex (double word).
Sets the baud rate for the fieldbus interface USS.

Displays or sets the address for the fieldbus interface USS. The address can be set as follows: 1) Using the address switch on the Control Unit. --> p2021 displays the address setting. --> A change only becomes effective after a POWER ON. 2) Using p2021 --> Only if an address of 0 or an address that is invalid for the fieldbus selected in p2030 has been set using the address switch. --> The address is saved in a non-volatile fashion using the function "copy from RAM to ROM". --> A change only becomes effective after a POWER ON.

descriere_scurta: Field bus int USS PZD no.
descriere: Sets the number of 16-bit words in the PZD part of the USS telegram for the field bus interface.

descriere_scurta: Field bus int USS PKW no.
descriere: Sets the number of 16-bit words in the PKW part of the USS telegram for the field bus interface.
Sets the communication protocol for the field bus interface.

descriere_scurta: Fieldbus interface USS PIV drive object number
descriere: Sets the drive object number for communication via the field bus interface (USS).

Sets the interface mode of the PROFIdrive control words and status words. When selecting a telegram via p0922 (p2079), this parameter influences the device-specific assignment of the bits in the control and status words.
Displays the interface mode of the PROFIdrive control words and status words.

Sets the serial interface for the debug monitor. The serial interface for the debug monitor is COM1 (X140) or COM2 (internal). Value = 0: COM2 (internal) Value = 1: COM1 (X140), commissioning protocol is de-activated Value = 2: COM2 (internal) Value = 3: Reserved
Sets the monitoring time to monitor the process data received via the internal communications interface. If no process data is received within this time, then an appropriate message is output.
Sets the PROFIBUS Ident Number (PNO-ID).

Sets the delay time to initiate fault F01910 after a setpoint failure. The time until the fault is initiated can be used by the application. This means that is is possible to respond to the failure while the drive is still operational (e.g. emergency retraction).

descriere_scurta: PB/PN clock synchronous controller sign-of-life signal source /
descriere: Connector input for the sign-of-life of the clock synchronous PROFIBUS/PROFINET controller. The sign-of-life is expected at bits 12 to 15. Bits 0 to 11 are not evaluated. The sign-of-life signal is normally received in PZD4 (control word 2) from the controller.

Sets the additional monitoring time to monitor the process data received via PROFIBUS. Enables short bus faults to be compensated. If no process data is received within this time, then an appropriate message is output.
Sets the sampling time for the cyclic interface 1 (IF1).

Setting for asynchronous participation in isochronous operation. Re p2049 = 1: The axis only asynchronously participates in isochronous PROFIdrive operation. The control sampling times of this axis are not included in the bus cycle time check (Tdp), in the time of the actual value sensing (Ti) and in the time of the setpoint sensing (To). Re p2049 = 0: No effect on the setting in p0092.
Sets the start for the SIC/SCC telegram (p60122) in the receive words (r2050, r2060).
Sets the start for the SIC/SCC telegram (p60122) in the send words (p2051, p2061).

descriere_scurta: Response receive value after PZD failure
descriere: Sets the response for the receive value (r2090) after PZD failure.

descriere_scurta: IF1 PROFIdrive PZD telegram selection extended
descriere: Sets the send and receive telegram. Contrary to p0922, a telegram can be selected using p2079 and subsequently expanded.
Sets the signal source to acknowledge all faults at all drive objects of the drive system.
Sets the first signal source to acknowledge faults.
Sets the second signal source to acknowledge faults.
Sets the third signal source to acknowledge faults.
Sets the signal source for external fault 1.
Sets the signal source for external fault 2.
Sets the signal source for external fault 3. External fault 3 is initiated by the following AND logic operation: - BI: p2108 negated - BI: p3111 - BI: p3112 negated
Number of alarms that have occurred after the last reset.
Sets the signal source for external alarm 1.
Sets the signal source for external alarm 2.
Sets the signal source for external alarm 3.

descriere_scurta: Delete fault buffer of all drive objects
descriere: Setting to delete the fault buffer of all existing drive objects.
Sets the configuration of the technology controller.
Sets the scaling for the setpoint 1 of the technology controller.
Sets the scaling for the setpoint 2 of the technology controller.
Sets the ramp-up time of the technology controller.
Sets the ramp-down time of the technology controller.

descriere_scurta: Technology controller setpoint filter time constant
descriere: Sets the time constant for the setpoint filter (PT1) of the technology controller.
Sets the type of technology controller.

descriere_scurta: Technology controller actual value filter time constant
descriere: Sets the time constant for the actual value filter (PT1) of the technology controller.

descriere_scurta: Technology controller upper limit actual value
descriere: Sets the upper limit for the actual value signal of the technology controller.

descriere_scurta: Technology controller lower limit actual value
descriere: Sets the lower limit for the actual value signal of the technology controller.
Sets the scaling factor for the actual value of the technology controller.
Setting to use an arithmetic function for the actual value signal of the technology controller.

descriere_scurta: Technology controller actual value inversion (sensor type)
descriere: Setting to invert the actual value signal of the technology controller. The inversion depends on the sensor type for the actual value signal.
Sets the time constant for the differentiation (D component) of the technology controller.
Sets the proportional gain (P component) of the technology controller.
Sets the integral time (I component, integrating time constant) of the technology controller.
Sets the maximum limit of the technology controller.
Sets the minimum limit of the technology controller.
Sets the ramping time for the output signal of the technology controller.
Sets the scaling for the output signal of the technology controller.
Setting to invert the fault signal of the technology controller. The setting depends on the type of control loop.

Sets the signal source for the selection of the "Switch-in motor" function. When the function is selected, monitoring of the switches is de-activated with the "bypass" function. This means that the power unit can be connected to other motors via an external control without switch monitoring responding.
Sets the signal source for the position setpoint of the position controller.
Sets the signal source for the velocity setpoint of the position controller.
Sets the signal source for the position actual value of the position controller.
Sets the signal source for the adaptation of the proportional gain of the position controller.

descriere_scurta: LR position controller output velocity limit
descriere: Setting and connector output for the velocity limit of the position controller output.

descriere_scurta: LR position controller output velocity limit signal source
descriere: Sets the signal source for the position controller output limit.

Sets the standstill window for the standstill monitoring function. After the standstill monitoring time expires, it is cyclically checked whether the difference between the setpoint and actual position is located within the standstill window and, if required, an appropriate fault is output. Value = 0 --> The standstill monitoring is de-activated.

Sets the standstill monitoring time for the standstill monitoring function. After the standstill monitoring time expires, it is cyclically checked whether the difference between the setpoint and actual position is located within the standstill window and, if required, an appropriate fault is output.

Sets the positioning window for the positioning monitoring function. After the positioning monitoring time expires, it is checked once as to whether the difference between the setpoint and actual position lies within the positioning window and if required an appropriate fault is output. Value = 0 --> The positioning monitoring function is de-activated.

Sets the positioning monitoring time for the positioning monitoring. After the positioning monitoring time expires, it is checked once as to whether the difference between the setpoint and actual position lies within the positioning window and if required an appropriate fault is output.
Sets the cam switching position 1.
